rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.05, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-7 (breast_ct). OUTER-LR probe. iters 1-6: step/depth/loss/sharing all collapse step[k]->~0, recon=FBP, hr0, MSE floor 0.00624. At outer lr=5e-3 the log_step slides smoothly into the collapse basin. HYPOTHESIS: a 10x outer lr (5e-3->5e-2, matching the Mayo un-stick run) makes Adam take large jumps in log_step space that may overshoot PAST the collapse attractor into a regime where a non-zero step does net denoising before settling. ONE KNOB: lr 5e-3->5e-2 (step_init=1e-3, lambda_init=1e-3, K=10, mse, per-iter -- iter-3 base). FALSIFIER: if the larger lr just reaches the SAME step->0 collapse faster (hr0), outer-lr is not an escape and the attractor is optimiser-step-size-agnostic. BUDGET: K=10 mse ~750s, <1200s wall.
